parts.t: Brookswood is a South Langley neighbourhood known for larger lots, rural character and family-friendly streets near Campbell Valley Park. It is also at the centre of some of the Township’s biggest planning changes, so the rules around a lot matter as much as the house on it.

Written by Jared Gibbons, REALTOR®, Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, on October 7, 2026, from public sources and my own work in Langley. Planning rules change, so confirm anything important with the Township.
Not legal, planning or financial advice. Confirm zoning, plan designations and school catchments before you buy or sell.

parts.t: Brookswood is one of the areas where the rules have moved the most, so check the lot, not the neighbourhood.
Brookswood sits in the Brookswood-Fernridge Community Plan area, with the Booth, Fernridge and Rinn neighbourhood plans guiding future growth.

Provincial SSMUH (small-scale multi-unit housing) legislation requires municipalities to allow more housing types on single-family lots. Langley revised its Brookswood neighbourhood plans in response.
What is allowed on a specific lot depends on its zone, its plan designation, lot size, servicing, and tree and environmental rules, plus any covenants on title.
A neighbour’s subdivision or townhouse project does not mean the same thing is possible on your lot.

Brookswood is in the Township of Langley, on the west side of the municipality and south of the Nicomekl River. It is part of the Brookswood-Fernridge Community Plan area.
Generally larger lots with a rural feel, but sizes vary street to street. Check the lot size on the listing and the zoning for the exact address.
Can I subdivide or build more than one home on a Brookswood lot?

It depends on the lot. Provincial SSMUH rules require municipalities to allow small-scale multi-unit housing on single-family lots, and Langley revised its Brookswood plans in response. What is possible on your lot depends on its zone, plan designation, size, servicing and environmental rules. Send me the address and I’ll check.
